content: Sɑɑ ɡɑɑ sisi yè sɔɔ bɑ koo womu ɡeni ko Yudɑn tem sɔɔ bu nɛɛ,

content.text: sɑ wuu dɑmɡuu mɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u ɡen ɡbɑ̃rɑru swĩi
u kɑ ɡu kɔ̃su.
I ɡɑmbobɑ kɛniɔ
kpɑ bwese te tɑ ɡem swĩi tɑ nùn mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ
tu du min di.
Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑ sikɑ sɑriruɡii bɔri yɛndu wɛ̃,
yèn sɔ̃ yɛ̃ro u nùn nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ.
I Yinni Gusunɔ nɑɑnɛ koowo
sɑɑ kpuro sɔɔ.
Domi wiyɑ u sɑ̃ɑ kuku yee dɑmɡiru
sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
U koo wuu ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ
wɔllɔn tɔmbu kpeerɑsiɑ,
kpɑ u ɡen tii kɔsuku u surɑ sere temɔ,
kpɑ sɑ̃ɑrobu kɑ wɔnwɔndobu
bu ɡu tɑɑku.
Gemɡiin swɑɑ yɑ rɑ n dɛndewɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɛ wi ɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡemɡii
wunɑ ɑ rɑ ye nɔɔ nɛrɑsie.
Yinni Gusunɔ, swɛɛ yi kɑɑ sun sure kpuro,
wunɑ sɑ ko n nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ,
su kɑ sĩ yi sɔɔ.
Ye bɛsɛn ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ kĩ,
yerɑ su nun yɑɑyɑ kpɑ su nun sɑ̃.
Wɔ̃kuru, nɛn bwɛ̃rɑ yɑ rɑ n wunɛn bɛkɛ bɑrɔwɑ,
kpɑ nɛn ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ n nun kɑsu.
À n tɔmbu siri hɑnduniɑ sɔɔ,
bɑ rɑ ɡiewɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ koo kɑ sĩ.
Adɑmɑ bɑɑ bɑ̀ n tɔn kɔ̃so durom kuɑ,
u ǹ ɡem ɡiɑmɔ.
U ko n win kom kɔ̃sum mɔ̀wɑ
tem mi ɡem mu wɑ̃ɑ,
kpɑ u n Gusunɔn yiiko ɡɛmɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ dɑm mɔ,
ɑdɑmɑ wunɛn yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ ǹ mu wɑɑmɔ.
A de bu wunɛn hɑniɑ wɑ
ye ɑ kɑ wunɛn tɔmbu wɔrɑmɔ,
kpɑ bu sekuru wɑ bu dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, wunɑ ɑ rɑ sun bɔri yɛndu wɛ̃.
Domi wunɑ ɑ rɑ de ye sɑ mɔ̀ kpuro yu koorɑ.
Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni sɑ rɑɑ yinnibu ɡɑbu sɑ̃wɑ.
Adɑmɑ tɛ̃, wunɛ turon yĩsirɑ sɑ soku.
Yinni, be bɑ ɡu,
bɑ ǹ mɑɑ seemɔ bu wɑ̃ɑru di.
Domi ɑ bu wɔri ɑ kpeerɑsiɑ.
Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ bu yɑɑyɑmɔ.
Yinni, ɑ wunɛn yiiko sɔ̃ɔsi.
A derɑ bɛsɛ wunɛn tɔmbu sɑ dɑbiɑ.
Mɑ ɑ bɛsɛn tem yɑsiɑsiɑ.
Sɑ nun sokɑ sɑnɑm mɛ sɑ wɑ̃ɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ.
Sɑ kɑnɑru kuɑ sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ sun sɛɛyɑsiɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ sun biru kisi
sɑ kuɑ nɡe tɔn kurɔ wi u yiire u kĩ u mɑ,
u tii bɔɔkumɔ u wuri mɔ̀ wuriribun sɔ̃.
Sɑ wɑhɑlɑ kuɑ sɑ nɔni sɔ̃ɔrɑ kɑ wuriribu.
Adɑmɑ wom dirumɑ sɑ mɑrɑ.
N ǹ kɑ tem mɛ ɑrufɑɑni ɡɑɑ nɑɑwɛ.
Sɑ ǹ mɑɑ ɡoo mɑrɑ wi u koo sinɑ mɛ sɔɔ.
Nɛɡibu, bɛɛn tɔn be bɑ rɑɑ ɡu
bɑ koo se ɡɔrin di bu wɑ̃ɑru di.
Bɛɛ be i kpĩ tem sɔɔwɔ, i dom yɑndo,
kpɑ i nuku dobun kuuki ko.
Domi tem mu koo bɛɛ seeyɑ ɡɔrin di
nɡe mɛ bururun kɑkoru tɑ rɑ yɑkɑsu seeye.
Nɛn tɔmbu, i doo i kuke bɛɛn diɑɔ
i tii ɡɑmbobɑ kɛnusio,
kpɑ i n wɑ̃ɑ mi ɡinɑ
sere Gusunɔn mɔru yu kɑ sure.
Wee Yinni Gusunɔ u yɑrimɑ
win wɑ̃ɑ yerun di
u kɑ hɑnduniɑn tɔmbu siri
kɔ̃sɑ ye bɑ kuɑn sɔ̃.
Tem mu koo tɔn be bɑ ɡon yɛm terɑsiɑ,
kpɑ ben ɡonu nu sɔ̃ɔsirɑ.
